name: Euler CFG++ node sampler (core nodes_advanced_samplers)
plain: An alternative form of CFG++ in core, chosen by version=alternative on the Euler CFG++ sampler node (version=regular uses euler_cfg_pp instead). It is the plain Euler step whose derivative is taken with the x−x̂_cfg+x̂_u substitution.
math: d = (x − x̂_cfg + x̂_u − x̂_cfg)/σ, x_t = x + d·dt (to_d with x replaced by x − x̂_cfg + x̂_u).

evidence.symbol: d = to_d(x - denoised + temp[0], sigmas[i], denoised)

label: from code

audit.note: nodes_advanced_samplers.py:136-139: sample_euler_pp is what version='alternative' of the Euler CFG++ node selects; 'regular' uses ksampler euler_cfg_pp. Nothing in the code shows it is older, and the update is not the same as the regular form. Math is correct.
